trajectory_summary: The call opens with unusually high customer enthusiasm and the rep converts it into a booked appointment for the next day at 2pm, holding scope discipline and the no-proposal-before-meeting rule under mild pressure. Energy dipped briefly around an accidental hang-up and some fumbling with the manager-hold/bill logistics, but recovered by the end. The interest question was never asked, leaving an anchor unused despite an explicit trust-gift moment (prior door-knock visit) late in the call.
